Julie,

Thanks — received and reviewing. High level answers to your two asks:
- Retention: SIG v7 introduced a clearer separation of "transient inference cache" vs. "persistent logs." Our Hosted API retains request/response logs for up to 30 days by default; Dedicated and Private customers can configure retention via the Console or APIs (and we Surface KMS/HSM options for keys).
- Material diffs: three answers you flagged relate to updated key-management descriptions and a change in our incident notification SLAs. No new third-party certifications were added; it's rewording to match our Dedicated/Private feature set.

I'll pull the draft of the v7 re-answers and a redline PDF showing diffs and share by EOD tomorrow. Looping in Marissa for legal sign-off on the wording we plan to publish.

Best,
Irene
